card.name: The word "by" before route of administration
card.fires_on: The word "by" right after a dose, drug name or frequency, where the next words give the route (mouth, oral inhalation, non-intravenous routes).

modes.label: By mouth
modes.description: "by" after a dose or frequency, leading into "mouth".
modes.example: the maximum recommended dosage is one tablet of 45 mg/105 mg<< by>> mouth once daily in the morning.

modes.label: By other routes
modes.description: "by" after a drug or dose, leading into inhalation or a non-intravenous route.
modes.example: 50 mcg (1 actuation of Fluticasone Furoate ELLIPTA 50 mcg) once daily<< by>> oral inhalation

card.plain: It marks the word "by" that introduces how a drug is given, such as by mouth or by inhalation.
